property_summary: For any inputs, C.transfer returns true iff every external transferFrom call to the callee succeeds; the mutant that removes require(_s) can return true even when at least one callee invocation reverts, so there exists inputs (a failing callee and recipient list including that recipient) where the mutant returns true but the reference reverts.
change_summary: Remove the require(_s) so that failed external calls do not revert and the function can return true while some calls failed, changing the returned value observable on success paths.
